title: A Dy6 Cluster Displays Slow Magnetic Relaxation with an Edge-to-Edge Arrangement of Two Dy3 Triangles

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear Dy6 cluster with an edge-to-edge arrangement of two Dy3 triangles

synthesis.procedure: A methanol solution of triethylamine (0.8 mL, 0.4 mmol) was added to H3L (0.2 mmol, 63 mg) dissolved in methanol (4 mL) and the mixture was stirred for 1 h. Solid dysprosium nitrate hexahydrate (0.2 mmol, 95 mg) was then added and the resulting yellow solution was stirred for 1 h. Acetonitrile (10 mL) was subsequently added. The mixture was left unperturbed for slow solvent evaporation. Yellow single crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained after one week.
synthesis.time: stirred 1 h after base addition, then 1 h after metal addition; crystals after 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: left unperturbed to allow slow evaporation of the solvent; yellow single crystals obtained after one week

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility and magnetization plus ac susceptibility show slow magnetic relaxation for this planar Dy6 cluster of two edge-to-edge Dy3 triangles. χMT decreases from 83.6 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K to 56.6 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization at 2 K and 70 kOe reaches 35.2 μB without saturation. Frequency-dependent χ′ and χ″ appear at low T without χ″ peaks versus T, attributed to fast QTM; Arrhenius analysis of frequency-dependent χ″ under zero dc field gives Δ = 3.2 K and τ0 = 2.8 × 10−5 s.
